ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 7.8:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/shadow pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) dominance in the central lobe areas; low-intensity (black) continuous mapping along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; localized low-intensity punctate blobs distributed throughout the white field, with higher density in the medial region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured internal vertex angle of approximately 64 degrees; vertical depth from lobe summits is roughly 14% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude pixel variations along the continuous boundary; serrations are most pronounced at the distal terminals with peak-to-valley amplitudes reaching 15 pixels; edge profile shows significant irregularity consistent with heavy wear.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curves originating from the median notch, transitioning to highly irregular, non-linear trajectories at the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular low-intensity pixel clusters (radius 4-12 pixels) concentrated on the right distal tip and the central-left lobe surface, suggesting barnacle attachment sites or localized scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel linear low-intensity disruptions (approx. 35-50 pixels in length) visible on the left lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the horizontal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe jagged irregularity and probable tissue loss at both distal tips; the right tip exhibits a multi-pronged, broken profile compared to the more continuous curve of the inner lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, isolated V-shaped dark pigmentation mark located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe.
